summary_en: THE Global Co., Ltd. (TSE 3271) made wholly owned subsidiary of Daito Trust Construction effective 2026-07-31. Tender offer: 12,715,775 shares (44.92% of S/O ex-treasury) acquired 2026-05-28. Stock consolidation 2026-07-30 reduced non-Daito shareholders to SBI Holdings only. Treasury stock acquisition by THE Global (8 shares post-consolidation) of SBI Holdings' stake completed today, achieving 100% ownership by Daito.
title_en: Notice Regarding Full Subsidiary Status of THE Global Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief: On 2026-07-31, Daito Trust Construction Co., Ltd. completed the acquisition of THE Global Co., Ltd. (listed on TSE, code 3271) as a wholly owned subsidiary. The transaction proceeded in stages: (1) A public tender offer launched 2026-04-07 for all ordinary shares of THE Global except those held by SBI Holdings (14,705,000 shares, 51.95% of S/O) and the company's own treasury stock. Daito acquired 12,715,775 shares (44.92% of S/O ex-treasury) by settlement date 2026-05-28, becoming a related company. (2) A stock consolidation approved at an extraordinary shareholder meeting 2026-07-09, effective 2026-07-30, which reduced minority shareholders to SBI Holdings and Daito only and converted SBI's stake to 8 shares post-consolidation. (3) A treasury stock acquisition by THE Global of SBI Holdings' post-consolidation shares (8 shares), funded by a third-party allotment of non-voting preferred shares subscribed by Daito and a capital reduction, completed effective today. The full chain of transactional procedures announced 2026-04-06 is now complete, and THE Global is fully owned by Daito. THE Global's business includes condominium sales, rental property, sales agency, building management, and hotel operations; it reported FY2025-06 net profit of ¥3,683M and per-share net profit of ¥130.14.
